义项: 名词 音乐的速度（music tempo 音乐节拍）
名词 (引申义) （活动、生活）节奏（the tempo of change 变化的速度）

例句.英文: In a study of the effects of music tempo (as measured in beats per minute, or bpm) during exercise, participants jogged outdoors for 30 minutes while listening to Beyoncé’s “Irreplaceable” (88 bpm) continuously.
例句.中文: 在一项关于运动时音乐节拍（以每分钟拍数 bpm 计）影响的研究中，参与者一边连续听碧昂丝的《Irreplaceable》（88 bpm），一边在户外慢跑 30 分钟。

例句.英文: Many believe that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, contain some acoustic features that are universally calming to infants.
例句.中文: 许多人相信，以缓慢节拍为特征的摇篮曲，含有对婴儿普遍具有安抚作用的声学特征。

义项: 名词 画家使用的色彩范围（a limited color palette 有限的色彩组合）
名词 (引申义) （可供选择的）全部手段、风格范围

例句.英文: Artists’ palettes—the surfaces on which painters arrange and mix their paints—can provide valuable insights into the painters’ creative processes.
例句.中文: 刻意简化的人物，配以鲜明而有限的色彩。

例句.英文: Contrasting a high saturation color palette against dark paper and stoneware, Atlanta-based artist Jiha Moon creates fused pieces, wherein Korean folk art, Western contemporary art, and global popular culture mix.
例句.中文: 以高饱和配色对照深色纸张与炻器，驻亚特兰大的艺术家 Jiha Moon 创作出融合之作：韩国民间艺术、西方当代艺术与全球流行文化在其中交汇。

义项: 名词 资金的花费（taxable expenditures 应税支出）
[辨析] 比 expense 更正式，常指机构、政府层面的开支

例句.英文: … by Reason,2003-2005 80 70 60 50 40 30 20 10 Percentage of total penalty 0 self-dealing uted income expenditures taxable expenditures undistributed income ress business holdings ess business Reason for tax penalty ■2003□2004■2005 While US public charities …
例句.中文: （图表：2003–2005 年提交 4720 表的私人基金会各类原因税务处罚占比）……而美国的公共慈善机构（如国际仁人家园）必须每年向国税局（IRS）申报 990 表……

义项: 名词 教士群体的总称（a high-ranking clergy member 一位高级神职人员）
[辨析] 集合名词，单复数同形；与 laity（平信徒）相对

例句.英文: Charles James is the son of a high-ranking clergy member. Charles James was an exact and careful boy; he never committed himself; he well knew how much was expected from the eldest son of the Archdeacon of Barchester; and was therefore mindful not to mix too freely with other boys.
例句.中文: 查尔斯·詹姆斯是一位高级神职人员的儿子。他是个一丝不苟、行事谨慎的男孩，从不轻易表态；他深知作为巴切斯特副主教的长子，人们对他期许有多高，因此留心不与其他男孩过分厮混。

义项: 名词 认为某事物卑劣而不屑一顾（repudiated with contempt 被轻蔑地否弃）
[辨析] contempt for 而非 contempt to；形容词 contemptuous

例句.英文: … was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick.
例句.中文: 在密西西比乡下，一个被称为「陌生人」的男人正走在一群他圈在围栏里的野性花斑马之间。那些马在栏中甩动、旋转，像碗里晕头转向的鱼。此前这围栏看似很大，但此刻，那么多暴烈的动能竟然都发生在一道围栏之内，这念头让人觉得可鄙，像变戏法一样该被轻蔑地否弃。

义项: 名词 引导行为的外部线索（an additional cue 额外的线索）
[辨析] on cue 恰在此时；v. 给…提示（cue the music）

例句.英文: Researchers Ximena Bernal and Priyanka de Silva wondered if the calls alone are sufficient for midges to locate the frogs or if midges use carbon dioxide emitted by frogs as an additional cue to their prey's whereabouts, like mosquitoes do.
例句.中文: 研究者 Ximena Bernal 与 Priyanka de Silva 想知道：仅凭鸣声是否足以让蠓找到青蛙，还是蠓会像蚊子那样，把青蛙排出的二氧化碳当作定位猎物的额外线索。

例句.英文: In the wild, crustose coralline algae (CCA) promote growth in the healthy reefs they inhabit by releasing lipids and other metabolites—chemical cues that trigger coral larvae settlement.
例句.中文: 在野外，壳状珊瑚藻通过释放脂质与其他代谢物——触发珊瑚幼虫附着的化学信号——促进其栖居的健康珊瑚礁的生长。

义项: 名词 直接向消费者销售商品的商家（an online retailer 网络零售商）
[辨析] retail 零售 → retailer；与 wholesaler（批发商）相对

例句.英文: For example, a marketing study simply trying to identify the average amount customers spend per transaction at an online retailer has a straightforward central question that doesn’t require many years of data collection.
例句.中文: 例如，一项只想弄清顾客在某网络零售商处每笔交易平均消费额的营销研究，其核心问题十分直接，并不需要多年数据收集。

例句.英文: But in one of the experiments, Sevilla and Townsend arranged the same jewelry with different levels of intervening space at an upscale retailer (Tiffany & Co.) and a relatively inexpensive retailer (Forever 21).
例句.中文: 在其中一项实验里，Sevilla 与 Townsend 把相同的珠宝以不同的间距陈列，分别放在高档零售商（蒂芙尼）和相对平价的零售商（Forever 21）。

义项: 名词 织物、纺织材料（textile artist 纺织艺术家）
形容词 (引申义) 纺织的；textile industry 纺织业

例句.英文: When using hairy coneflower for dyeing cloth, textile artists first soak it in water to release its color.
例句.中文: 用毛金光菊染布时，纺织艺术家首先把它泡入水中以释出颜色。

例句.英文: Developed in the Edo period (1603‑1868) in Japan to mend clothing and domestic textiles, sashiko uses tightly spaced rows of stitching to beautify and reinforce worn cloth.
例句.中文: 刺子绣于江户时代（1603-1868）创于日本，本为修补衣物与家用织品，以细密成排的针脚美化并加固磨损的布料。

义项: 形容词 因不谙世事而天真、轻信的（naive to the new medium 对这种新媒介毫无概念）
[辨析] 与 gullible（易受骗的）不同；席勒美学中与 sentimental 相对

例句.英文: When the 50-second-long film Arrival of the Train—which depicts what its title says, a train pulling into a station—was first shown publicly in 1896, spectators, naive to the new medium of film and seeing a train appearing to come directly at them, leaped from their seats and fled the room.
例句.原书高亮: naive to the new medium of film
例句.中文: 1896 年，那部 50 秒的影片《火车进站》——内容正如片名所说，一列火车驶入车站——首次公开放映时，观众对这种新生的电影媒介毫无概念，看到火车仿佛直冲自己驶来，纷纷从座位上跳起、逃出放映厅。

例句.英文: Our belief that the coming of film was transformative is so strong that we invented and keep retelling a founding myth that divides cultural history into a (naive) “before” and (sophisticated) “after.”
例句.中文: 我们对「电影的到来具有变革性」这一信念如此强烈，以至于发明并不断重述一个奠基神话，把文化史切成（素朴的）「之前」与（成熟的）「之后」。

义项: 动词 看、注视（多用于书面、庄重语境）（I behold these steep and lofty cliffs 我凝望这些陡峭高耸的崖壁）
[辨析] 古雅、文学化； behold! 看哪！

例句.英文: Once again Do I behold these steep and lofty cliffs, Which on a wild secluded scene impress Thoughts of more deep seclusion; and connect The landscape with the quiet of the sky.
例句.原书高亮: I behold these steep and lofty cliffs
例句.中文: 我又一次凝望这些陡峭高耸的崖壁，它们在一片荒野幽僻的景致上，印下更深的幽居之思，并把这片山水与天空的宁静连成一体。

义项: 动词 以为、料想（reckon sth to be）；名词 reckoning 清算、估算
动词 (引申义) 计算、估算；reckon with 应对、考虑到

例句.英文: The Reckoning and Resilience (2022) exhibition at Duke University's Nasher Museum of Art was the first to focus entirely on North Carolina artists since the exhibition Across County Lines four years earlier.
例句.中文: 杜克大学纳舍尔艺术博物馆 2022 年的展览《Reckoning and Resilience》，是自四年前的《Across County Lines》以来首个完全聚焦北卡罗来纳州艺术家的展览。

例句.英文: Any assessment of the state of contemporary poetry must reckon with the professionalization of the field.
例句.中文: 任何对当代诗歌现状的评估，都必须直面这一领域的职业化。

义项: 形容词 与空间分布、尺度相关的（across spatial scales 跨越不同空间尺度）
[辨析] 与 temporal（时间的）相对；名词 spatiality 空间性

例句.英文: Because research tends to focus on large-scale effects in cities, decision-makers may be unaware that those outcomes are not always generalizable across spatial scales.
例句.中文: 由于研究往往聚焦城市中的大规模效应，决策者可能并不知道这些结果未必能跨空间尺度推广。

例句.英文: Animal dispersers may congregate at varying distances from parent trees, may carry seeds for varying lengths of time, and may have idiosyncratic spatial trajectories.
例句.中文: 动物传播者可能在距母树不同距离处聚集，携带种子的时长各异，行进的空间轨迹也各有癖性。

义项: 动词 补充而使整体更完善（complementing its surroundings 与周边环境相得益彰）
[辨析] 与 compliment（称赞）同音异义；形容词 complementary 互补的

例句.英文: A two- dimensional photograph, however, cannot capture how a building interacts with its surroundings, whether by complementing, blending in with, or perhaps even clashing with sights and activities nearby.
例句.中文: 然而，一张二维照片无法呈现建筑与周边环境的关系——它是与近旁的景物和活动相得益彰、融为一体，还是格格不入。

例句.英文: Computational models can be used to analyze biological mechanisms, complementing the findings of direct experimentation.
例句.中文: 计算模型可用于分析生物机制，与直接实验的发现互为补充。

义项: 形容词 当前在任、在位的（incumbent cities 原有城市）
名词 (引申义) be incumbent on sb 是某人的职责；n. 现任者

例句.英文: Based on the data, the researchers concluded that growth of the manufacturing sector in these counties during this period mainly occurred outside incumbent cities.
例句.中文: 基于这些数据，研究者得出结论：这一时期这些县制造业的增长主要发生在原有城市之外。

义项: 形容词 值得相信的（more credible than messages from doctors 比医生的信息更可信）
[辨析] 与 credulous（轻信的）、creditable（值得称赞的）区分

例句.英文: When communications researcher Sungkyoung Lee and her colleagues tested messages seeking volunteers for clinical trials, however, they found that participants in their study judged recruitment messages from former trial volunteers as significantly more credible than messages from doctors (i.e., credentialed experts).
例句.中文: 然而，当传播学研究者 Sungkyoung Lee 及同事检验招募临床试验志愿者的信息时，他们发现，研究参与者认为由曾参加试验的志愿者发出的招募信息，显著比医生（即具有专业资质的专家）发出的信息更可信。

例句.英文: A incontrovertible B dubious C credible D advantageous According to a study led by Claire Heeryung Kim, artifact emojis—pictorial symbols representing objects, such as a flower—generally elicit consumer skepticism when used in digital marketing messages.

义项: 形容词 永存不灭的（immortal marble 不朽的大理石）
[辨析] 与 immortal 相对的是 mortal（会死的）；immortality 不朽

例句.英文: … fresh and fair;All palpitating from the master’s hand,The last touch of his chisel lingering there.“And surely this shall last!” he proudly thought;“Fixed in immortal marble is my fame!”Just here …
例句.中文: 这尊新生儿维纳斯曾在此伫立，清新而秀美；周身仿佛还带着匠人之手的余温，凿刀最后一触仍留在那里。「这必定永存！」他自豪地想，「我的声名已镌入不朽的大理石！」而就在这确曾有人工雕琢之处，几个斑驳的字母或许曾拼出他的名字。

义项: 名词 以个人经历为线索的记述（her 2016 memoir 她 2016 年的回忆录）
[辨析] 与 autobiography 不同：memoir 侧重特定经历与时代，不求涵盖一生

例句.英文: Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge is an 1838 historical account by Elleanor Eldridge and Frances Harriet Whipple Green.
例句.中文: 《埃莉诺·埃尔德里奇回忆录》（Memoirs of Elleanor Eldridge）是 Elleanor Eldridge 与 Frances Harriet Whipple Green 于 1838 年写成的历史记述。

例句.英文: The following text is adapted from Yone Noguchi’s 1914 memoir The Story of Yone Noguchi.

义项: 名词 生物个体的子代（from a parent to offspring 由亲代传向子代）
[辨析] 单复数同形；与 descendant 相比更偏生物学语境

例句.英文: Vertical gene transfer involves the transmission of genetic material from a parent to offspring; horizontal gene transfer, on the other hand, involves the exchange of genetic material between organisms not in a parent-offspring relationship.
例句.中文: 垂直基因转移指遗传物质由亲代传给子代；而水平基因转移则指并非亲子关系的生物之间交换遗传物质。

例句.英文: After the eggs hatch, the noncuckoo parents will typically raise the cuckoo chicks as if they were their own offspring, even if the cuckoos look very different from the other chicks.
例句.中文: 蛋孵化后，被寄生的宿主父母通常会像养育亲生后代一样抚养杜鹃雏鸟——即便它们的长相与其他雏鸟大相径庭。

义项: 名词 文化、制度在时间上的连贯（ensuring cultural continuity 确保文化延续）
[辨析] 与 coherence（逻辑连贯）不同；反义 discontinuity 断裂

例句.英文: The percent of cities and towns in a given period that persist from a prior period (backward continuity) and the percent that persist into a later period (forward continuity) are known to correlate positively with economic and political stability in a region.
例句.中文: 一个时期内的城镇中，从上一时期延续下来的比例（后向延续性），以及延续到下一时期的比例（前向延续性），已知与一个地区的经济政治稳定性呈正相关。

例句.英文: A student writing a paper for a film-studies class contends that Schoonmaker’s priority was to focus scenes around the actors’ performances and that she therefore prioritized performance over surface continuity.
例句.中文: 一位电影课写论文的学生主张：斯科塞斯剪辑师 Schoonmaker 的首要考量是让场景围绕演员的表演展开，因此她把表演置于表面连贯性之上。

义项: 动词 使某人或某物处于某种状态（renders irrigation essential 使灌溉成为必需）
动词 (引申义) 提供、给予（render assistance）；翻译、演绎（render into English）

例句.英文: The student claims that California's climate renders irrigation an essential component of agriculture in some parts of the state but not in others.
例句.中文: 这名学生主张，加利福尼亚的气候使灌溉在该州部分地区成为农业的必要条件，而在另一些地区则不然。

例句.英文: Knurled and twisted, rendered birdlike by age, they luxuriated in the sun’s comfort.
例句.中文: 它们疙疙瘩瘩、虬曲盘绕，因年深日久而颇似禽鸟，正惬意地晒着太阳。

义项: 名词 同一事物略有差异的版本（a particular variant 一种特定变体）
[辨析] 与 variation（变化、变异程度）区分；基因语境指「等位变异型」

例句.英文: The researchers found that small domestic dogs (e.g., Yorkshire terriers) as well as small wild canids (e.g., foxes) tend to have a particular variant, known as the C allele, of the gene IGF1, a growth-related gene found in all mammals.
例句.中文: 研究者发现，小型家犬（如约克夏㹴）以及小型野生犬科动物（如狐狸）往往带有一种特定变体，称为 C 等位基因，位于 IGF1 基因上——这是所有哺乳动物都具有的一个与生长相关的基因。

例句.英文: Elena Markovic, Priya Nair, and colleagues analyzed a large sample of honey bees (Apis mellifera) collected from most US states, assessing mitochondrial DNA markers to identify three major evolutionary lineages—North Mediterranean, West Mediterranean, and African—and the distinct haplotypes (inherited DNA variants) ass

义项: 动词 控制、限制（curbing emissions 遏制排放）
名词 (引申义) 路缘；put a curb on 对…加以约束

例句.英文: While many initiatives aimed at limiting atmospheric warming focus on curbing emissions of methane (CH₄), a greenhouse gas that is typically generated by microbially mediated processes, Lisa Y.
例句.中文: 尽管许多旨在限制大气变暖的举措聚焦于遏制甲烷（CH₄）排放……

义项: 形容词 依个人判断而定、缺乏客观标准的（is subjective 是主观的）
[辨析] 与 objective（客观的）相对；名词 subjectivity 主观性

例句.英文: How we define a neighborhood and its boundaries is subjective, so the team used a clustering algorithm to locate dense groupings of amenities that represent human-identified neighborhoods like Boston's Central Square.
例句.中文: 我们如何界定一个街区及其边界是主观的，因此团队使用聚类算法，定位出代表人们心目中的街区（如波士顿的联合广场）的密集设施群。

义项: 名词 无尽的时间（into deep eternity 深入永恒的深处）
[辨析] 与 forever 相比更庄重、更具哲学意味；形容词 eternal

例句.英文: Exultation is the going Of an inland soul to sea, —Past the houses, past the headlands,Into deep eternity! Bred as we, among the mountains,Can the sailor understand The divine intoxication Of the first league out from land?
例句.中文: 欢腾，是内陆的灵魂出海远航——越过房屋，越过海岬，驶入永恒的深处！我们生于群山之间，水手能否领会初离陆地一里格时那份神圣的沉醉？

义项: 名词 长期对立、争夺同一目标的关系（dog rivalry 犬只间的竞争）
[辨析] 比 competition 更强调「对立情绪」；rival 竞争者

例句.英文: This was the case for both dog rivalry and energy but was especially pronounced for chasing, which can be seen when a dog pursues small animals like birds or squirrels.
例句.中文: 在「犬只竞争」与「兴奋度」这两个行为类别上情况如此，而在「依恋」与「寻求关注」（可见于犬只主动讨要亲近或注意时）上尤为明显。

义项: 形容词 明确无疑、具权威性的（a definitive interpretation 定于一尊的解读）
[辨析] 与 definite（明确的）近义，但 definitive 更含「权威、终极」意味

例句.英文: Mackey's long song's open-endedness is essential to the way it manifests discrepant engagement-that is.the work's associative logic and resistance to linear narrative prevent readers from imposing a definitive and coherent interpretation onits presentation of world cultures.
例句.中文: 作品的联想式逻辑与对线性叙事的抗拒，使读者无法对其呈现的世界诸文化强加一个确定而连贯的解读。

义项: 名词 意见、事实的相符（in accord with 与…一致）
动词 (引申义) 给予（accord sb respect）、相符；accordance 依照

例句.英文: Canada, which, according to international indices, has relatively strong democratic institutions and low intranational income inequality, experienced an inflation rate of 2.26% in 2018, whereas Oman, which shows the opposite pattern on such indices, had an inflation rate of only 0.88% that year.
例句.中文: 根据国际指标，加拿大拥有相对强有力的民主制度，国内收入不平等程度较低，2018 年通胀率为 2.26%；而阿曼在这些指标上呈现相反的模式，当年通胀率却仅为 0.88%。

例句.英文: According to journalist Graeme Wood, Bloom claimed to have read Crowley's novel Little, Big at least forty-six times, and in his posthumously published afterword to a 2022 edition of the book, Bloom called himself its "lifelong enthusiast" and described it as a "masterwork. "
例句.中文: 据记者 Graeme Wood 记述，Bloom 声称至少把 Crowley 的小说《Little, Big》读过 46 遍；在其身后出版的 2022 年版跋文中，Bloom 自称该书「终生的拥趸」，并称之为「杰作」。

义项: 名词 使参与者继续留在项目中的比率（recruitment and retention 招募与留存）
名词 (引申义) 记忆力、保持；动词 retain 保留

例句.英文: Melissa Valerio and colleagues tested whether a method called snowball sampling could improve recruitment and retention.
例句.中文: Melissa Valerio 及同事检验了一种名为「滚雪球抽样」的方法能否改善招募与留存。

义项: 形容词 前所未有、无先例可循的（unprecedented fair weather 空前晴好的天气）
[构词] un- 否定 + precedent 先例 + -ed；常与 in modern history 搭配

例句.英文: We landed in New York on the 12th of April, 1847, after a passage of ninety-eight days of unprecedented fair weather.
例句.中文: 1847 年 4 月 12 日，我们抵达纽约，全程九十八天，天气晴好得前所未有。

例句.英文: She went through the crucible of unprecedented adversities and trials of life and came out one of the rare shining lights that beautify the New England sky.
例句.中文: 她历经前所未有的逆境与人生试炼，终成点亮新英格兰天空的稀有明灯之一。

义项: 名词 引发反应的外部作用（a stimulus captures attention 刺激物吸引注意）
[辨析] 复数 stimuli；经济语境指「刺激措施」

例句.英文: Bainbridge and colleagues also measured pupil size, as pupils typically become larger when a stimulus captures a person’s attention.
例句.中文: Bainbridge 及同事还测量了瞳孔大小，因为当某个刺激物吸引人的注意时，瞳孔通常会放大。

义项: 名词 突然而猛烈的上升（storm surges 风暴潮）
动词 (引申义) 激增、涌动（prices surged）

例句.英文: Cardiff, Wales, has installed engineered structures—mainly breakwalls—along 87% of its shoreline to protect infrastructure from storm surges and other hazards, a practice known as shoreline hardening.
例句.中文: 威尔士的卡迪夫在 87% 的海岸线上修建了工程结构——主要是防波堤——以保护基础设施免受风暴潮及其它危害，这种做法被称为海岸硬化。

例句.英文: A multiyear study called GREEN SURGE examined forty-four different types of UNAs (urban natural areas) in cities throughout Europe..
例句.中文: 一项名为 GREEN SURGE 的多年期研究考察了欧洲各城市 44 种不同类型的城市自然区域（UNA）。

义项: 名词 一位作者的全部作品清单（in his bibliography 在他的著作序列中）
[辨析] 与 filmography（作品年表）类比；亦指论文末尾的参考文献

例句.英文: The films of Martin Scorsese released starting in 2016 have the same place in his filmography that the late novels of Henry James have in his bibliography.
例句.中文: 马丁·斯科塞斯 2016 年起推出的影片，在其作品序列中的地位，恰如亨利·詹姆斯晚期小说在其全部著作中的地位。

义项: 动词 对作品、观点作系统评析（is critiqued for his style 因文风而受批评）
[辨析] 比 criticize 更偏学术、分析性；与 criticism 近义

例句.英文: Lucian of Samosata (modern-day Turkey) was a second-century satirist who mostly published critiques of philosophers of the time.
例句.中文: 阿西莫夫因文风而受批评，但指责一位作家没有做到他本就无意去做的事，是不对的。

例句.英文: Aubert result from men’s greed—suggests that underlying the satire is a social critique.
例句.中文: ……Aubert 源于人类的贪婪——这提示讽刺的底层是一种社会批判。

义项: 动词 使人感到有趣（more entertaining 更具娱乐性）
[辨析] 另一义为「怀有（想法）」entertain an idea；两义在 SAT 中都考

例句.英文: Though it is lighter in tone—more entertaining, even—this literary “joke” nonetheless engages seriously with the themes that motivated the four or five other novels by Woolf that have achieved the status of literary classics.
例句.中文: 尽管这本书调子更轻——甚至更具娱乐性——这则文学「玩笑」仍然严肃地处理了促使伍尔夫另四五部跻身文学经典的小说成形的那些主题。

例句.英文: Recently, however, younger Native writers have embraced popular genres known for being entertaining and suspenseful, such as fantasy and horror.
例句.中文: 然而近来，更年轻的原住民作家已拥抱以娱乐性和悬念著称的流行类型，如奇幻与恐怖。

义项: 名词 （常为夸张的）英勇事迹（the exploits of male characters 男性角色的功绩）
[辨析] 名词读 /ˈeksplɔɪt/，动词 /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/ 意为「利用、剥削」

例句.英文: In classical Greek and Roman mythology, female characters are typically cast as either villains lacking in psychological depth or passive victims who are marginal to these stories, which usually focus on the exploits of male characters.
例句.中文: 在古希腊罗马神话中，女性角色通常被塑造成两类：要么是缺乏心理深度的反派，要么是处于故事边缘的被动受害者——这些故事通常聚焦于男性角色的功绩。

义项: 名词 智慧超凡的人（the SAGE study 全球老龄化与成人健康研究）
[辨析] 另一义为「鼠尾草」；形容词 sagacious 睿智的

例句.英文: The Study on Global Ageing and Adult Health (SAGE) seeks to discover long-term trends related to aging by compiling and analyzing evidence from approximately 66,000 participants in multiple countries.
例句.中文: 「全球老龄化与成人健康研究」（SAGE）旨在通过汇总分析多国约 66,000 名参与者的证据，揭示与老龄化相关的长期趋势。

例句.英文: Run by researchers in multiple countries, the Study on Global Ageing and Adult Health (SAGE) is an examination of ageing that has attempted to track approximately 66,000 people for several years.
例句.中文: 由多国研究者联合运营的「全球老龄化与成人健康研究」（SAGE）是一项老龄化考察，试图连续数年追踪约 66,000 人。

义项: 名词 纽约市等大城市的行政区（New York City's borough of Queens 纽约市皇后区）
[辨析] 英国指有自治特权的市镇；与 district 相比更具行政实体意味

例句.英文: Most speakers of Chinese languages reside in the neighborhood of Flushing (part of New York City's borough of Queens), where the dominant Chinese language is Mandarin, and in Chinatown, in the borough of Manhattan, where the dominant Chinese languages are Cantonese and Fuzhounese.
例句.中文: 多数使用汉语诸语言者居住在法拉盛一带（属纽约市皇后区），那里占主导的汉语是普通话；另一些住在曼哈顿的唐人街，那里占主导的是粤语与福州话。

义项: 名词 用于测试的最初模型（the team's prototype 团队的样机）
[构词] proto- 最初 + type 型；动词 prototype 制作原型

例句.英文: Though slight, the reductions inspired an air-cooling device; using approximately 400 grams of mushrooms, the team's prototype lowered the air temperature in a controlled environment by 10°C in forty minutes.
例句.中文: 尽管降幅不大，这些降低仍催生了一种空气冷却装置：团队用约 400 克蘑菇制成的样机，在四十分钟内把受控环境的空气温度降低了 10°C。

义项: 形容词 事物本身固有、不可分离的（inherently unrelated things 本无关联的事物）
[辨析] 与 intrinsic 近义；inherent in 而非 inherent to

例句.英文: Biologist Ari Martinez and colleagues hypothesized that the greater vulnerability inherent in the latter strategy is reflected in greater sensitivity to predator warning signals from neighboring species.
例句.中文: 生物学家 Ari Martinez 及同事提出假说：后一种策略固有的更大脆弱性，体现为对来自邻近物种捕食者警报信号的更强敏感性。

例句.英文: Taking a deconstructionist approach to analyzing Ji-li Jiang’s novel Red Scarf Girl would lead a critic to focus on the linguistic structures inherent in the novel.
例句.中文: 以解构主义的路径分析姜吉丽的小说《红领巾女孩》，评论者会聚焦小说固有的语言结构。

义项: 形容词 因某事而广为人知（多含贬义）（notorious for its strict requirements 以要求严苛著称）
[辨析] 与 famous 不同：notorious 几乎总带负面色彩

例句.英文: Although notorious for its strict formal requirements, the sonnet is nevertheless represented by such wide-ranging examples as Maggie Anderson’s “Sonnet for Her Labor” and Tyehimba Jess’s “Millie and Christine Mc Coy”—poems that differ remarkably in subject, rhythm, and structure.
例句.原书高亮: notorious for its strict formal requirements
例句.中文: 尽管商籁体以其严苛的形式要求著称，却仍涌现出题材、节奏与结构差异极大的众多范例，如 Maggie Anderson 的《Sonnet for Her Labor》与 Tyehimba Jess 的《Millie and Christine McCoy》。

例句.英文: He was famous in the building for his fine set of tools, and notorious for his willingness to share them—by playing his cards right, he was able to follow them into someone else’s fixing and repairing.
例句.中文: 他以楼里一套上好的工具闻名，也以乐于外借而声名狼藉——只要玩好手中的牌，他就能跟着工具一起进入别人家的修理现场。

义项: 名词 图像、视觉素材的总称（aerial imagery 航空影像）
名词 (引申义) （文学中的）意象群；image → imagery

例句.英文: Research by Zander S. Venter et al.comprised data from air-quality monitoring stations in Austria, the US state of California, and thousands of other global locations over a ten-year span, coupled with aerial imagery of those locations from the same period.
例句.中文: Zander S. Venter 等人的研究涵盖奥地利、美国加利福尼亚州以及全球数千个地点十年间的空气质量监测站数据，并配有同期这些地点的航空影像。

例句.英文: compared data from air-quality monitoring stations in Liechtenstein, the US state of Illinois, and thousands of other global locations over a ten-year span, coupled with aerial imagery of those locations from the same period.

义项: 名词 由部分组合成整体（the synthesis of superheavy elements 超重元素的合成）
[辨析] 与 analysis（分析）相对；动词 synthesize，形容词 synthetic

例句.英文: The synthesis of novel superheavy elements, such as darmstadtium (Ds), has led theorists to consider the feasibility of synthesizing all possible chemical compounds.
例句.原书高亮: The synthesis of novel superheavy elements
例句.中文: 新型超重元素（如𨧀 Ds）的合成，促使理论家去考虑合成所有可能的化合物的可行性。

例句.英文: Digital Light synthesis (DLS) is a form of additive manufacturing that utilizes light to rapidly cure liquid resin into high-quality, 3D objects..
例句.中文: 数字光合成（DLS）是一种增材制造形式：利用光把液态树脂快速固化成高质量的立体物件。

义项: 动词 使模糊、难以看清（obscuring those beliefs 遮蔽那些信仰）
形容词 (引申义) 晦涩的、无名的（an obscure poet 无名诗人）

例句.英文: Any examination of Luttrell’s reputation should note this offense. Text 2Some historians claim that though Luttrell was responsible for the creation of the Luttrell Psalter, this should not obscure his mistreatment of his neighbors.
例句.中文: 对 Luttrell 声誉的任何审视都应记下这桩恶行。——一些历史学家主张，尽管 Luttrell 主持创作了《Luttrell 诗篇集》，但这不应遮蔽他虐待邻居的事实。

例句.英文: Purists argue that such efforts represent a distinctively modern tendency to impose our own values on past civilizations, obscuring those civilizations’ beliefs.

义项: 名词 两事物在形貌、结构上的相符（the correspondence of… to… 与…的对应）
名词 (引申义) 通信、往来书信；形容词 corresponding 相应的

例句.英文: Noting the correspondence of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa to his self-portrait in red chalk, artist Lillian Schwartz argued that the Mona Lisa is, in a sense, a self-portrait, too—by mapping his own features onto those of its ostensible subject, Lisa del Giocondo, Leonardo depicted himself as a woman.
例句.原书高亮: the correspondence of Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa to his self-portrait
例句.中文: 艺术家 Lillian Schwartz 注意到达·芬奇《蒙娜丽莎》与他红色粉笔自画像之间的对应关系，据此主张《蒙娜丽莎》在某种意义上是自画像——通过把自己的面部特征映射到画中表面上的对象丽莎·盖拉尔迪尼脸上，达·芬奇把自己画成了一个女人。

例句.英文: Most Native languages belong to language families, or groups of languages whose structural and lexical correspondence likely derives from their descent from a single language spoken long ago.

义项: 名词 主张女性平等权利的思想与运动（Black Feminism 黑人女性主义）
[构词] femine 女性 → feminism；feminist 女性主义者

例句.英文: In her 1998 book Blues Legacies and Black Feminism, Angela Y. Davis bases her analysis in part on recordings of songs sung in the 1920s by Gertrude "Ma" Rainey and Bessie Smith.
例句.中文: 安吉拉·戴维斯在她 1998 年的著作《蓝调遗产与黑人女性主义》中，部分分析基于 1920 年代格特鲁德·「妈」·雷尼与贝西·史密斯所唱歌曲的录音。

例句.英文: In her 1998 book Blues Legacies and Black Feminism, Angela Y.
例句.中文: 在她 1998 年的著作《布鲁斯遗产与黑人女性主义》中，Angela Y. Davis……

义项: 形容词 呈螺旋形的（a spiral galaxy 螺旋星系）
名词 (引申义) 螺旋；v. 螺旋式上升或下降（spiraling costs）

例句.英文: Using the Stratospheric Observatory for Infrared Astronomy (sOFIA), a team of astronomers mapped out the magnetic field of G47, one of the Milky Way's galactic bones (dense clouds of gas and dust that run through the middle of the arm of a spiral galaxy).
例句.中文: 借助同温层红外天文台（SOFIA），一组天文学家绘制出了 G47 的磁场——G47 是银河系「银道骨」之一（贯穿旋臂中部、由气体与尘埃构成的致密云团）。

例句.英文: India has classified the spiraling whitefly as an invasive species that could harm some of the country's native species.
例句.中文: 印度已把螺旋粉虱列为可能危害本国部分本土物种的入侵物种。

义项: 名词 物种在生态系统中的功能位置（ecological niches 生态位）
名词 (引申义) （市场、社会中的）适切位置（carve out a niche）

例句.英文: While mammals collectively exhibit the highest ratio of brain size to body size among vertebrates, a team led by paleontologist Ornella Bertrand demonstrates that for ten million years following the extinction of dinosaurs, that ratio in fact shrank for mammals as they evolved to fill newly vacated ecological niches and their bodies increased in size more rapidly than their brains.
例句.中文: 尽管哺乳动物整体上在脊椎动物中脑体比最高，但古生物学家 Ornella Bertrand 领导的团队表明，在恐龙灭绝后的一千万年里，随着哺乳动物演化去填补新腾出的生态位、且体型增长快于脑容量，这一比值实际上缩小了。

例句.英文: Some features, such as the mihrab (or niche), are present in nearly every mosque.
例句.中文: 某些特征，如米哈拉布（壁龛），几乎存在于每一座清真寺中。

义项: 形容词 独立运行、不受外部控制的（autonomous flying vehicles 自主飞行器）
[构词] auto- 自 + nomos 法则 → autonomy 自治；autonomous motivation 自主性动机

例句.英文: One advance in last-mile delivery is the use of aerial drones (autonomous flying vehicles that can deliver small packages).
例句.中文: 末端配送的一项进展是使用无人机（能够投递小件包裹的自主飞行器）。

例句.英文: The present-day city of Dushanbe, Tajikistan, was the capital of the Tajik Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic, one of many nominally autonomous republics within the Soviet Union.
例句.中文: 今日塔吉克斯坦的杜尚别曾是塔吉克自治苏维埃社会主义共和国的首都——苏联境内众多名义上自治的共和国之一。

义项: 名词 两变量同步变化的统计关系（this correlation 这一相关性）
[辨析] 相关不等于因果；动词 correlate，形容词 correlated

例句.英文: But Stéphane Guédron, Delphine Tisserand, and colleagues did not find this correlation in an examination of freshwater bodies impacted by wastewater, leading some scientists to hypothesize that the association could be particular to undisturbed waters.
例句.中文: 但 Stéphane Guédron、Delphine Tisserand 及同事在考察受废水影响的淡水水体时，并未发现这一相关性，这使一些科学家假设，该关联可能只存在于未受干扰的水体中。

例句.英文: But Mark E. Brigham and colleagues did not find this correlation in an examination of freshwater bodies disturbed by urban development, leading some scientists to hypothesize that the association could be particular to undisturbed waters.
例句.中文: 但 Mark E. Brigham 及同事在考察受城市开发扰动的淡水水体时并未发现这一相关性，这促使一些科学家推测：该关联可能仅见于未受扰动的水体。

义项: 名词 政治实体自主治理的权力（the sovereignty of Indigenous tribes 原住民族的主权）
[构词] sovereign 君主的、有主权的 → sovereignty

例句.英文: The NCAI was created to protect the sovereignty of Indigenous tribes.
例句.中文: NCAI 的创立宗旨是保护原住民族的主权。

例句.英文: But Nixon's legacy is complex: he has been praised for his role in affirming the sovereignty of tribal nations, and he once made an attempt at reforming United States health care policy that is arguably a precursor to the Affordable Care Act, which became law during the Barack Obama administration.
例句.中文: 但尼克松的遗产是复杂的：他因肯定部落国家的主权而受赞誉，而他当年对美国医疗政策的一次改革尝试，也可以说是《平价医疗法案》的先声——后者在奥巴马任内成为法律。
